[.verse-line]
[.i140]##{nbsp}##‘For us thro’ 12 bright signs Apollo guides
[.i142]##{nbsp}##‘The year, and earth in sev’ral climes divides.
[.i144]##{nbsp}##‘Five girdles bind the skies, the torrid zone
[.i144]##{nbsp}##‘Glows with the passing and repassing sun.
[.i139]##{nbsp}##‘Far on the right and left, th’ extreams of heav’n,
[.i142]##{nbsp}##‘To frosts and snows and bitter blasts are giv’n.
[.i142]##{nbsp}##‘Betwixt the midst and these, the Gods assign’d
[.i142]##{nbsp}##‘Two habitable seats for humane kind.
